summary: Refactor regression for MAK FIN PAY (CODE QUALITY only — no business changes intended). 34/34 backend pytest cases pass. Verified: admin login (Bearer token), admin_stats_financial across all 6 date ranges (today/yesterday/7d/30d/lifetime/custom) with invariant total_revenue == admin_revenue + distributor_earnings, admin-created distributor gets commission_type='default' & default percent, admin-created agent has creator_name='Admin' in listing, distributor-created agent base+markup math + commission_type='custom', GET /admin/distributors/{id}/agents returns {distributor, agents}, commission cascade to default-mode distributors AND admin-created default-mode agents on default-percent change, full recharge approve → wallet credit → ledger flow, bill payment (pending status, wallet debited by bill+service_charge), admin reject refund, withdrawal create+reject refund, audit logs, MongoDB indexes. Frontend smoke: Landing renders all 8 service cards with NEW stable test-ids (service-card-mobile/electricity/dth/broadband/water/gas/fastag/creditcard), Why/Vision/Mission/Benefits/Values/Contact sections visible, nav login navigates to /login, admin login reaches /admin, sidebar shows all 11 nav items (Overview, Distributors, Agents, Recharge Approvals, Withdrawals, Transactions, QR Codes, Commission, KYC Review, Audit Logs, Change Password).

minor.issue: Admin POST /admin/users IGNORES body.commission_percent — distributor/agent always created with platform default. If admin needs to set custom commission at creation, this must be done via the PATCH commission endpoints after creation. Behaviour is consistent but undocumented; consider validating/honoring input or returning 400 when provided.
Distributor body.commission_percent is interpreted as MARKUP (added on top of distributor base), not as total commission. Frontend/API contract should be documented to avoid confusion.
Inherited from iteration_1 — admin role returns {'balance': 0} (plain dict) while others return full wallet doc.
Inherited from iteration_1 — allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False (cookie-based auth ineffective cross-origin).
